test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Unless sales improve next month, the company will be __in a critical position in which failure seems imminent__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. up against the wall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"up against the wall"** means being in a difficult or desperate situation where options are limited. (मुश्किल में होना)

 
 
• **Example: **With the deadline approaching and no work done, the team was up against the wall.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. up against the wall.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hitting the sack **(सोने जाना): Going to bed to sleep.

 
 
• **Example:** After a long day at work, she was looking forward to hitting the sack early.
 
 
 
• **A mare's nest **(भ्रमपूर्ण स्थिति ): A complex and confused situation; a false discovery.
 
 
• **Example: **His claim of finding the treasure was nothing but a mare's nest.
 
 
 
• **A damp squib** (निराशाजनक परिणाम): Something that fails to meet expectations; an anticlimax.
 
 
• **Example:** The much-hyped event turned out to be a damp squib.
 
 

 

16e:T774,
The correct answer is Option 1</s
